title: Introduce a fast-track approval tier for low-risk requests
description: Define clear thresholds under which routine requests need a single approver instead of a full chain, and publish target turnaround times.

title: Add failover and a public status page for core systems
description: Stand up automated failover for the order-management system and a shared status page so teams see incidents and recovery in real time.

title: Define ownership (RACI) for cross-team handoffs
description: Agree a simple responsibility map for the top three cross-team workflows and attach a handoff checklist to each.

relatedThemeName: Manual re-entry between systems causes rework
title: Integrate finance and operations systems to remove manual re-entry
description: Scope a one-way sync between the two finance systems to eliminate the most frequent double-entry path.

title: Scale the onboarding buddy program org-wide
description: Roll the buddy program out to all departments and add a lightweight check-in at 30 and 60 days.

title: Refresh field equipment and set a replacement SLA
description: Audit field equipment, replace the oldest units, and publish a replacement service level so gaps do not recur.
